findings.finding: AS-v2 frontmatter still has a specifies relation to /architecture/AS-001/verification_plan-v2.md, while the baseline candidate activates verification_plan-v3.md and the favorable independent review explicitly reviews VP-v3 as the corrected dependent evidence. This stale relation makes the proposed active AS dependency index contradict the activation set and risks resolving the old R-001 due-stage plan after activation.

reviewed_claims: Approved scope authority supports newest-32 accepted-sample semantics and assigns uninterrupted ordered delivery to the upstream publisher as an unverified external responsibility.

The explicit Option A decision provisionally reaffirms AP-002 for CON-first under corrected AS-v2 and supersedes only the protected 1 ms applicability premise; C-002, C-003, PR-002 and F-001 remain protected.
The favorable independent AS review is independent and covers AS-v2, VP-v3 and proposed VO-004-v2; it does not activate them.

Candidate VO identities, states, evidence receipt fields, requirements and owners match the current ledger. VO-004 due-stage change from TARGET_VALIDATION to IMPLEMENTATION is explicitly authorized and remains OPEN.
AD-003 remains accepted with its original owner, final-acceptance deadline, checkpoints, fallback and F-001 uncertainty. No new debt or Pareto claim is introduced.

The candidate excludes unsupported detector-side loss epochs, watchdogs, fixed 1 ms cadence, physical publisher verification, and concurrent-reader guarantees. PR-002 remains limited to abstract arithmetic and ring recurrence assumptions.
unresolved_obligations: VO-002, VO-003, VO-004, VO-005 and VO-006 remain OPEN; VO-001 remains limited to the synthetic input domain.
Publisher continuity is an external unverified assumption.
AD-003 and the final F-001 comparison remain open under their existing authority and deadlines.
No baseline activation, CON/DE approval, implementation, physical publisher evidence or VO discharge is established.
